stem.text: The dative covalent bond can be represented by an arrow, $\rightarrow$. The arrow points towards the atom receiving the lone pair.
Which diagram of an ammonium ion is correct?

A.alt: Ammonium ion in brackets with charge +: N bonded to three H in the plane, with a dative arrow from the top H down to N.

B.alt: Ammonium ion in brackets with charge -: N bonded to three H in the plane, with a dative arrow from the top H down to N.

C.alt: Ammonium ion in brackets with charge +: N bonded to three H in the plane, with a dative arrow from N up to the top H.

D.alt: Ammonium ion in brackets with charge -: N bonded to three H in the plane, with a dative arrow from N up to the top H.
